![10 Tips for Writing Good User Stories](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/10081734-2633-0066-0000-dc6c384b61ae:4)
A user story is `a short, simple description of a software feature written from the perspective of an end user`.[[1]](https://www.atlassian.com/agile/project-management/user-stories)

### Standard Format

User stories generally follow this simple template:[[1]](https://www.coursera.org/articles/what-is-user-story)

- **As a** [type of user or persona]
- **I want** [an action or goal]
- **So that** [a benefit or business value][[1]](https://www.coursera.org/articles/what-is-user-story)

*Example:* As a frequent traveler, I want to save my favorite destinations in the app so that I can quickly access them for future trips.[[1]](https://www.coursera.org/articles/what-is-user-story)

### The 3 Cs Framework

Defined by Ron Jeffries, a user story consists of three vital parts:[[1]](https://www.mountaingoatsoftware.com/agile/user-stories)

- **Card:** A brief written reminder of the requirement, traditionally kept on a physical index card, Post-it note, or inside an agile tracking tool like Jira or Trello.
- **Conversation:** The verbal discussion between product owners, developers, testers, and stakeholders to flesh out details and edge cases.
- **Confirmation:** Acceptance criteria that define the exact conditions needed for the story to be considered finished.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/User_story)[[2]](https://www.mountaingoatsoftware.com/agile/user-stories)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kkihaNjwRik&t=26)

### Why Use User Stories?

- **Shifts focus to people:** Moves the team away from dry technical specifications and onto real human needs.
- **Encourages flexibility:** Defers deep technical details until the team is ready to build, preventing wasted work.
- **Improves collaboration:** Acts as a placeholder for ongoing team discussions rather than a rigid contract.[[1]](https://www.visual-paradigm.com/guide/agile-software-development/what-is-user-story/)[[2]](https://www.coursera.org/articles/what-is-user-story)[[3]](https://www.mountaingoatsoftware.com/agile/user-stories)

To learn more about structuring and breaking down items, check out the guide on [User Stories by Mountain Goat Software](https://www.mountaingoatsoftware.com/agile/user-stories) or explore project workflows on [Atlassian](https://www.atlassian.com/agile/project-management/user-stories).[[1]](https://www.atlassian.com/agile/project-management/user-stories)[[2]](https://www.mountaingoatsoftware.com/agile/user-stories)If you would like, share what **product or feature** you are working on, and I can help you draft a few user stories and acceptance criteria for it.
